Question: Asalamualaikum 1-If theres a fear of Satar opening up is it permissible for a Muhrim to put Stitches of thread in the lungi(bottom part of the Ihram cloth)? Answer ID: 14235 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1146/1146=M/1430) It is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
